1	"""Advisory health checks for the human/agent-maintained work queues.
2	
3	These checks deliberately never mutate state or fail a command.  They make the
4	workspace-hygiene guidance executable and visible to every CLI caller while
5	leaving room for a human or agent to decide that an unusually large collection
6	is intentional.
7	"""
8	
9	from __future__ import annotations
10	
11	from collections.abc import Sequence
12	from dataclasses import dataclass
13	from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
14	
15	from .clock import utc_now
16	from .inbox import InboxItem, InboxKind, InboxStatus, is_conversation
17	from .roadmap import RoadmapItem, RoadmapStatus
18	from .tasks import HorizonTask, TaskStatus
19	
20	
21	@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
22	class AdvisoryHealthLimits:
23	    """Central defaults for CLI collection-health warnings."""
24	
25	    open_memories: int = 10
26	    open_info: int = 4
27	    open_conversations: int = 8
28	    open_inbox: int = 30
29	    open_tasks: int = 12
30	    active_roadmap: int = 8
31	    stale_running_task_hours: int = 24
32	
33	
34	DEFAULT_HEALTH_LIMITS = AdvisoryHealthLimits()
35	
36	
37	def _as_utc(value: datetime) -> datetime:
38	    """Normalize legacy naive timestamps before comparing their age."""
39	    if value.tzinfo is None:
40	        return value.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
41	    return value.astimezone(timezone.utc)
42	
43	
44	def inbox_health_warnings(
45	    items: Sequence[InboxItem], limits: AdvisoryHealthLimits = DEFAULT_HEALTH_LIMITS
46	) -> list[str]:
47	    """Warnings for an inbox whose open working set may need pruning."""
48	    open_items = [item for item in items if item.status is InboxStatus.OPEN]
49	    warnings: list[str] = []
50	    counts = {
51	        kind: sum(item.kind is kind for item in open_items)
52	        for kind in (InboxKind.MEMORY, InboxKind.INFO)
53	    }
54	    if counts[InboxKind.MEMORY] > limits.open_memories:
55	        warnings.append(
56	            f"Inbox has {counts[InboxKind.MEMORY]} open memory items "
57	            f"(recommended maximum {limits.open_memories}) — archive stale, "
58	            "superseded, or no-longer-key memories if this is not intentional."
59	        )
60	    if counts[InboxKind.INFO] > limits.open_info:
61	        warnings.append(
62	            f"Inbox has {counts[InboxKind.INFO]} open info items "
63	            f"(recommended maximum {limits.open_info}) — archive notices that "
64	            "have been consumed if this is not intentional."
65	        )
66	    open_conversations = sum(is_conversation(item) for item in open_items)
67	    if open_conversations > limits.open_conversations:
68	        warnings.append(
69	            f"Inbox has {open_conversations} open conversations "
70	            f"(recommended maximum {limits.open_conversations}) — reply on an existing "
71	            "thread instead of opening a duplicate, and archive conversations you "
72	            "started once their conclusion has been consumed."
73	        )
74	    working_set = [item for item in open_items if item.kind is not InboxKind.PROTECTION]
75	    if len(working_set) > limits.open_inbox:
76	        warnings.append(
77	            f"Inbox has {len(working_set)} open non-protection items "
78	            f"(recommended maximum {limits.open_inbox}) — review duplicates and "
79	            "stale items; use `inbox complete` or `inbox archive` where appropriate."
80	        )
81	    return warnings
82	
83	
84	def task_health_warnings(
85	    tasks: Sequence[HorizonTask],
86	    limits: AdvisoryHealthLimits = DEFAULT_HEALTH_LIMITS,
87	    *,
88	    now: datetime | None = None,
89	) -> list[str]:
90	    """Warnings for an oversized task queue or apparently orphaned runs."""
91	    open_statuses = {TaskStatus.QUEUED, TaskStatus.RUNNING, TaskStatus.BLOCKED}
92	    open_tasks = [task for task in tasks if task.status in open_statuses]
93	    warnings: list[str] = []
94	    if len(open_tasks) > limits.open_tasks:
95	        warnings.append(
96	            f"Task queue has {len(open_tasks)} open tasks "
97	            f"(recommended maximum {limits.open_tasks}) — review whether some "
98	            "objectives are done, blocked, cancelled, duplicated, or better kept "
99	            "only as roadmap milestones."
100	        )
101	
102	    cutoff = _as_utc(now or utc_now()) - timedelta(hours=limits.stale_running_task_hours)
103	    stale = [
104	        task for task in tasks
105	        if task.status is TaskStatus.RUNNING and _as_utc(task.updated_at) < cutoff
106	    ]
107	    if stale:
108	        shown = ", ".join(task.id for task in stale[:4])

112	            f"{limits.stale_running_task_hours}h — confirm a run is still live or "
113	            "reset their status if it ended unexpectedly."
114	        )
115	    return warnings

120	) -> list[str]:
